# Psalm 50 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 50:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** 'Gather to-Me My-faithful-ones, the-ones-cutting My-covenant over sacrifice.'
- **LOGOS:** 'Gather to Me My faithful ones, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice!'
- **PNEUMA:** 'Bring My faithful people to Me — those who made a covenant with Me by offering sacrifices.'

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 50:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Not for-your-sacrifices do-I-rebuke-you; and-your-burnt-offerings [are] before-Me continually.
- **LOGOS:** Not for your sacrifices do I rebuke you; your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
- **PNEUMA:** I have no complaint about your sacrifices or the burnt offerings you constantly offer.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** I-will-not take from-your-house a-bull, [nor] from-your-pens male-goats.
- **LOGOS:** I will not accept a bull from your house or goats from your folds.
- **PNEUMA:** But I do not need the bulls from your barns or the goats from your pens.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 50:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-know every bird of-the-mountains, and-the-creatures of-the-field [are] with-Me.
- **LOGOS:** I know all the birds of the hills, and all that moves in the field is Mine.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 50:14 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Sacrifice to-God thanksgiving, and-pay to-the-Most-High your-vows.
- **LOGOS:** Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and perform your vows to the Most High,
- **PNEUMA:** What I want instead is your thankful hearts. I want you to fulfill your vows to the Most High.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 50:15 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-call-upon-Me in-the-day of-distress; I-will-deliver-you, and-you-will-glorify-Me.'
- **LOGOS:** and call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me.'
- **PNEUMA:** Trust Me in your times of trouble, and I will rescue you, and you will give Me glory.'
